headword: {学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}

definitions.gloss: student life; college life; school life
definitions.explanation: The period and experience of being a student, encompassing academics, social activities, daily routines, and personal growth during one's school or university years.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}を{楽|たの}しんでいる。
{学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}も{残|のこ}りわずかになった。
examples.english: My student life has almost come to an end.

examples.japanese: {充実|じゅうじつ}した{学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}るために、{勉強|べんきょう}だけでなくサークル{活動|かつどう}にも{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: To lead a fulfilling student life, I participated in club activities as well as studies.

notes:
A compound of {学生|がくせい} (student) and {生活|せいかつ} (life; daily life). Typically refers to university or college life, though it can encompass any period of being a student. A common topic in essays, speeches, and conversations about youth and education in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}る: to lead a student life
- {学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る: to look back on one's student days
- {充実|じゅうじつ}した{学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}: a fulfilling student life
- {最後|さいご}の{学生|がくせい}{生活|せいかつ}: one's last period as a student

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {学校|がっこう}{生活|せいかつ}: school life — more focused on daily routines at school (often elementary through high school)
- キャンパスライフ: campus life — loanword emphasizing the university campus experience
- {学生|がくせい}{時代|じだい}: student days — retrospective; referring to the time when one was a student
